title: monitor — the main branch is production; health.mjs watches template changes

steps: template filter: only .js/.css/.html/page.js trigger; ai/ data files never do
per-page check: console errors, 1920 shot, long-task stall > 2 s, settle within 10 s, unknown-verb count
report twice: health log + a log line in the editing agent's task.jsonl via append.mjs
prove the four cases, update Server/doc/health.md, commit, card
set.outcome: **The main-site monitor is built** — `Server/health.mjs` now checks only template changes (JS, CSS, HTML), never log appends. Each check finds console errors, flags a stall over 2 s or a page still busy at 10 s, counts unknown-verb warnings and takes a 1920 screenshot. It reports to the editing agent (as before) and as one line per batch on that agent's task card, including a task opened days ago. `health-supervisor.mjs` runs once per tree. Proofs: [stall shot](proof/stall-shot.png), [proof task log](proof/proof-task.jsonl), [watcher console](proof/watcher-console.log), [two supervisors](proof/supervisor-twice.log), [task lookup](proof/task-lookup.log), [batch line](proof/batch-line.log). Doc: `Server/doc/health.md`. Commits df74c22a, 8ef74ea2, b0a71a66 and d0c2c4f1 on worktree/proposal-flow. Left: the layout scan and item 8's cheap layout anomaly check, both later.
